name: Hero Talents
body:
Hero Talents | Advanced Hero Talents

As a generational hero gains experience, he learns a number of talents that aid him in completing tasks and defeating foes. Starting at 3rd level, the hero gains one hero talent. He gains an additional hero talent for every 2 levels of generational hero attained after 3rd level.

Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to the hero’s bombs. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual bomb, and the decision must be made before the attack roll is made.

At 11th level, and every two levels thereafter, a generational hero can choose an advanced talent in place of a hero talent.

Hero Talents
Samurai Sheepdog
Talent	Prerequisites	Benefits	Source
Blessed Water (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent is able to spend 1 point from his discovery pool to cast bless water a number of times per day equal to his Charisma modifier with a caster level equal to his generational hero level. Thrown holy water the hero creates with this ability is more potent than usual, dealing 1d6 points of damage per three generational hero levels to undead and evil outsiders struck by a direct hit. Creatures vulnerable to holy water and hit by the splash still only take 1 point of damage regardless of the hero’s level. Holy water a generational hero creates deals increased damage only when he throws it (not when he douses a creature with it). If given to another creature, it functions as normal holy water.	BoMT v2
Bomb Discovery (Su)*	Bombs class feature	A generational hero with this talent can choose one alchemist’s discovery that augments the bomb class feature. The hero treats his generational hero level as his effective alchemist level when qualifying for a discovery. This talent can be chosen more than once.	BoMT v2
Book of Ancients (Ex)	—	A generational hero with this talent adds Linguistics and Spellcraft to his list of class skills. He gains a bonus equal to his generational hero level to Spellcraft checks and to Linguistics checks made to translate text.	BoMT v2
Boomerang (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent is able to conjure a magical boomerang with a swift action that he can throw at enemies, temporarily dazing them. As a standard action, the hero throws his boomerang up to 60 feet at an enemy. If he succeeds with a ranged touch attack, the enemy takes bludgeoning damage equal to the hero’s Charisma modifier and is dazed for 1 round. A successful Reflex save negates the daze.	BoMT v2
Bracelet of Power (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent doubles his lifting and carrying capacity. He also ignores up to 5 points of an object’s hardness when attempting to damage it.	BoMT v2
Catterpillar’s Device	3rd level

A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point 2 per spell levels (rounded up) from her discovery pool and summon a special device as a swift action that allows her to create clouds of different substances. She can do this up to 3 times each day. When used, the device creates one of the following spell effects, then disappears. The hero cannot use the device to cast a spell with a level higher than half her generational level (rounded up).

Cloudkill, eurphoric cloud, fog cloud, incendiary cloud, and stinking cloud.

	BoMT v3
Champion’s Tunic (Ex)	—	A generational hero with this talent has customized his light armor so that it grants an additional +2 armor bonus, but also reduces its maximum Dexterity bonus by 1. Any other creature that dons the armor treats it as an ironwood breastplate. The hero can select this hero talent again as an advanced talent to increase both by +2 and 1, respectively. The armor is then treated as ironwood full plate by any other than the hero.	BoMT v2
Cheshin Companion (Ex)	5th level, a familiar	A generational hero with this talent gains Improved Familiar as a bonus feat, and her familiar becomes a cheshin. A cheshin grants its master the benefits of a cat. Up to 3 times per day, it can also cast dimension door (self only), hideous laugher, or vanish. The cheshin speaks Sylvan and one other language its master knows.	BoMT v3
Cheshin Dice (Sp)	5th level	A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point from his discovery pool per 2 generational hero levels to cast summon monster up to 3 times per day. The spell level of summon monster is equal to the number of points spent (up to 12 points for summon monster VI), and the hero can only summon evil monsters (such as demons, devils, and creatures with the fiendish template) regardless of his actual alignment.	BoMT v3
Drink Me Bottle (Sp)	The right size for the job wonderlander archetype feature.	A generational hero with this talent can cast enlarge person and reduce person on an ally up to 3 times per day each.	BoMT v3
Grappling Hook (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent can create a magical grappling hook as a standard action. The grappling hook counts as a piercing weapon with 10-foot reach that deals 1d6 damage (for a medium creature) with a successful attack and deals x3 damage on a successful critical hit. The hook can also extend out to 30 feet, puncture a solid surface (such as a wall or ceiling) and pull the hero to that location as a standard action. The hero will not fall while he continues to hold the grappling hook in at least 1 hand.	BoMT v2
Invisibility Cloak (Sp)	5th level	A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point from his discovery pool to cast invisibility up to 3 times each day.	BoMT v2
Jack’s Gift	Bombs or playing cards class feature

A generational hero with this talent can change between using bombs—as the generational hero class ability—and using playing cards—as the wonderlander archetype ability. Switching from one to the other is a move action that costs 1 point from the hero’s discovery pool. Switching back is a free action and costs no points.

	BoMT v3
Jacks	—

A generational hero with this talent can conjure a handful of non-magical caltrops or 5 shuriken with a swift action that he can throw at enemies. The hero is treated as being proficient with these items. The shuriken disappear when given to another creature or after being used to attack. The caltrops disappear after 1 minute or when the hero uses jacks again.

	BoMT v3
Mad Hatter’s Hat (Su)	7th level

A generational hero with this talent can conjure a top hat as a swift action that grants the hero a constant nondetection effect while worn. As a standard action, the hero can take off the hat and use it to cast dimension door up to 3 times per day. When used in this way, the hat disappears until conjured again.

	BoMT v3
Mallet (Su)	5th level

A generational hero with this talent can spend 2 or more points from his discovery pool as a swift action to transform his current weapon into a +1 shock earth breaker for 1 round per point spent. For every 2 points spent beyond the initial 2, increase the enhancement bonus by +1, change it into a shocking burst weapon, or add both the throwing and returning properties. The weapon loses any other properties while altered in this way.

	BoMT v3
Mystical Instrument (Sp)	Music adept

A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point from his discovery pool and summon a special instrument as a swift action that affords him greater control over his musical abilities. He can do this up to 3 times each day. When played the instrument can be used to create one of the following spell effects, then disappears.

Call animal, calm animals, charm animal, entangle, faerie fire, gust of wind, jump, longstrider, or whispering lore.

	BoMT v2
Pocket Watch (Sp)	—

A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point 2 per spell levels (rounded up) from her discovery pool and summon a special pocket watch as a swift action that affords her greater control over time. She can do this up to 3 times each day. When used, the watch creates one of the following spell effects, then disappears. The hero cannot use the pocket watch to cast a spell with a level higher than half her generational level (rounded up).

flash forward, haste, slow, time stop, wizened appearance, and youthful appearance.

	BoMT v3
Ring of Ages (Sp)	—

A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point from his discovery pool to cast a spell from the following list. He can do this up to 3 times each day.

Anticipate peril, blurred movement, darting duplicate, and true strike.

	BoMT v2
Rod of Seasons (Sp)	5th level

A generational hero with this talent can spend 1 point from his discovery pool to cast a spell from the following list. He can do this up to 3 times each day.

Goodberry, scorching ray, snowball, and windy escape.

	BoMT v2
Sword Dart (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent is able to conjure a magic shortsword as a swift action that he treats as a thrown weapon with a range of 30 feet. He can apply the enhancement bonus and appropriate properties of a magic weapon in his possession to his attacks with the sword.	BoMT v2
Teapot	9th level	A generational hero with this talent gains a magical teapot that functions as a gray (1), rust (2, 3, or 4), or tan (5 or 6) bag of tricks. Each time the hero uses the teapot, he must first roll 1d6 to determine which bag it functions as (see above). When not being used as a bag of tricks, the teapot functions normally.	BoMT v3
Tower Shield (Ex)	Shield Proficiency	A generational hero with this talent gains proficiency with tower shields and does not take the –2 penalty to attack rolls while using a tower shield.	BoMT v2
Whirling Strike (Ex)	BAB +6	A generational hero with this talent only takes a –3 penalty total to additional attacks made with a melee weapon as a result of a high attack bonus, but only when he attacks a different creature with each attack.	BoMT v2
Wonderland Blade (Su)	—	A generational hero with this hero talent gains a magical shortsword. At the beginning of each day, the hero can choose one creature type (or subtype if humanoid or outsider). The shortsword gains the bane magic weapon property against the chosen creatures.	BoMT v3
Wonderland Umbrella (Su)	—	A generational hero with this talent gains Deflect Arrows and Snatch Arrows as bonus feats that she can use up to 3 times per day total. When she uses this ability, the hero conjures a magic umbrella that disappears once she has used either feat.	BoMT v3
Advanced Hero Talents
Samurai Sheepdog
Talent	Prerequisites	Benefits	Source
Advanced Boomerang (Su)	Boomerang

This advanced talent allows a generational hero to spend 2 points from his discovery pool as a free action and make his boomerang count as a magical, adamantine weapon that he can throw in a line up to 120 feet as a full-round action which provokes attacks of opportunity. Each enemy in the line takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 2 generational hero levels and is staggered for 1 round. A successful Reflex save deals half damage and negates the stagger.

If chosen twice, the hero can instead throw his boomerang in a burst, centered on him, that hits each enemy within 30 feet.

	BoMT v2
Advanced Grappling Hook (Su)	Grappling Hook	This advanced talent allows a generational hero to pull enemies and items toward him with his grappling hook. His grappling hook attack now extends out to 30 feet and deals x4 damage on a successful critical hit. In addition, the hero gains the Improved Drag feat, but only when using his grappling hook. He treats the unoccupied space that is between him and his target and adjacent to the target as his original space when dragging in this way. Finally, the hero can also use the grappling hook to pull unattended items within 30 feet to him as a standard action.	BoMT v2
Aether Magic (Sp)	Book of Ancients

This advanced talent allows the hero to spend 1 point from his discovery pool and deal 5d6 cold damage to each enemy within 30 feet of him as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. A successful Reflex save deals half damage instead. The hero can use this ability once per day for each advanced talent he possesses.

If chosen twice, the hero deals 1d6 cold damage per 2 generational hero levels to enemies within 30 feet and enemies that fail their Reflex save are slowed for 1 round.

	BoMT v2
Blessed Arrows (Su)	17th level	This advanced talent grants the hero the ability to treat any bow or crossbow he wields as an oathbow, except that it still counts as a +2 weapon against foes other than a sworn enemy, and the hero takes no penalties to attack rolls with other weapons. The weapon loses any other properties while altered in this way.	BoMT v2
Bomb Magic (Sp)*	Book of Ancients	This advanced talent allows the hero to expend two of his bombs in a burst, centered on him, that hits each enemy within 30 feet for double the hero’s bomb damage. A successful Reflex save deals half damage instead. The hero can use this ability once per day for each advanced talent he possesses.	BoMT v2
Eye of the Jabberwocky (Sp)	19th level	This advanced talent allows the hero to spend 5 points from his discovery pool and cast meteor swarm once per day as a sorcerer of his generational hero level. Once the spell is cast, the hero is fatigued for 1 minute.	BoMT v3
Fairy’s Blessing (Su)	13th level	This advanced talent revives the recently slain hero once per day, as if he cast breath of life on himself from a scroll. If chosen twice, the hero can spend 3 points from his discovery pool to instead use it on a recently slain ally.	BoMT v2
Master Blade (Su)	17th level	This advanced talent grants the hero the ability to treat any longsword he wields as a holy avenger. The sword loses any other properties while altered in this way.	BoMT v2
Mirror Shield (Su)	15th level	This advanced talent grants the reflecting magic shield property to any metallic shield the hero wields.	BoMT v2
Ten-and-Six Hat	13th level, mad hatter’s hat

This advanced talent grants 1 additional use of the dimension door mad hatter’s hat effect and allows the hero to spend 1 point from his discovery pool and one use from his mad hatter’s hat to cast either greater teleport or plane shift (his choice).

	BoMT v3
Quake Magic (Sp)	13th level, Book of Ancients

This advanced talent allows the hero to spend 1 point from his discovery pool and cast one of the following spells of his choice. The hero can use this ability once per day for each advanced talent he possesses.

Binding earth, earth tremor, and soften earth and stone

Alternatively, the hero can spend 1 point from his discovery pool and two uses of this ability to cast one of the following spells.

Mass binding earth, move earth, and rampart

	BoMT v2
Vorpal Blade	15th level, Wonderland Blade

This advanced talent transforms the hero’s wonderland blade into a +4 bane vorpal shortsword. The vorpal property only functions against creatures that meet requirements and to which the bane property applies. A generational hero cannot have both this advanced talent and the master blade talent.

	BoMT v3
